name: Cherry Bounce
description: Historical recipe from The Whitehouse Cookbook (1887). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

instructions.text: Add enough good whisky to the cherries to cover the fruit
Let soak two or three weeks and then drain off the liquor

Add this liquor to that already drained off

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Add enough good whisky to the cherries to cover the fruit
2. Let soak two or three weeks and then drain off the liquor
3. Mash the cherries without breaking the stones and strain through a jelly-bag
4. Add this liquor to that already drained off
5. Make a syrup with a gill of water and a pound of white sugar to every two of liquor thus prepared
6. Stir in well and bottle
7. Tightly cork
